description: 👩 💻 The role We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company. Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter. This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months. If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you. 🤩 What makes this role special? Real problems, not busywork : Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard. Breadth of exposure : You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them. Learn fast by doing : You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep. A team that gives a damn : We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better. A product you can care about : Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new. 💝 What skills & experience do you need? 1 - 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand-holding. You know how to debug a slow query. Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI) Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e-commerce, consumer tech

Qualifications Essential Some experience of analysing problems, improving processes, supporting digital change or working with software teams is helpful. Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to break down problems, identify gaps and manage competing tasks. Good communication skills and the confidence to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Curious and willing to ask questions, learn from others and challenge existing ways of working constructively. Proactive, self-motivated and keen to develop a career in Business Analysis. Desired A degree in Business Analysis, Computing, Software Development or a related subject is desirable. Some understanding of Agile ways of working, such as Scrum or Kanban. Experience of using reporting or data tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar. Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools. An interest in digital products, software development and emerging technologies, including AI. Additional Information Why join BRCGS? Work on digital products used by organisations globally Develop your skills within an experienced product and technology team. Gain exposure to the full digital product development lifecycle. Work with experienced Business Analysts, Product Owners and software engineers. Explore innovative technologies, including practical AI applications. Build your skills and take on increasing responsibility as you develop.
